item.title: “Uma Forza”: AI-Assisted Fan-Project Mixes Uma Musume with Forza Horizon 4
item.description:
A YouTube creator has unveiled the Uma Forza fan project, an unusual experiment that brings elements of Forza Horizon 4 into Unity and populates its British open world with characters from Uma Musume: Pretty Derby. The creator showcases the results in a four-minute video.
The creator behind the PetracoreProxy channel explains that “Uma Forza” is neither a mod nor a public release, but a personal reverse-engineering project—although, as he acknowledges in the comments, it is not so personal anymore. He recreated Forza Horizon 4’s British world in Unity, including its map, buildings, roads, traffic, sky, weather, lighting, and sound.
In the video, Uma Musume characters such as Haru Urara and Agnes Tachyon run through the landscape, complete with custom 3D models, animations, and Japanese voice lines.
The project demonstrates how much AI-assisted game reverse engineering has advanced in recent months. Rather than simply swapping character models, the developer appears to have rebuilt major elements of Forza Horizon 4’s world, atmosphere, and cinematic presentation in Unity.
The appeal lies in the collision of two very different aesthetics: Playground Games’ serene British open world and polished racing cinematography meet Cygames’ colorful anime horse girls. The result looks like an absurd but surprisingly convincing crossover trailer, which may help explain why the clip spread so quickly.
Beyond showing the characters running around, the video offers little gameplay. Uma Musume: Pretty Derby is not a traditional racing game; it is a free-to-play training simulator with gacha mechanics, none of which are implemented in this project. The series’ signature 3D Winning Live concerts, which follow race victories, are absent as well.
The characters in Uma Musume: Pretty Derby are inspired by real Japanese racehorses, with their names and histories reimagined as anthropomorphic horse girls. The game launched in Japan in 2021 for iOS, Android, and PC. Its English version arrived in June 2025, and it won Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025.
Despite the enthusiasm, a public release seems unlikely. The reverse-engineering project is not endorsed or authorized by Microsoft, Playground Games, or Cygames.
Nevertheless, “Uma Forza” shows how creatively fans can push the boundaries of genres, licenses, and game engines. Microsoft’s racing franchise, Cygames’ Japanese gacha phenomenon, and Unity collide here—not as an official crossover, but as an impressive technical experiment by a single creator.
For the Uma Musume community, the project also taps into a wish-list item: an open-world racing game featuring the horse girls. Until then, “Uma Forza” remains a fascinating, yet unplayable glimpse of what such a game could look like.

item.title: NIKKE 4th Anniversary Update Arrives October 29 With Marian: Queen and 259 Free Recruitments
item.description:
The anniversary rewards add up to 259 free recruitments across the event period, which runs until November 18.
The update brings two new playable Nikkes and one free unit:
Main chapters 49 and 50 turn the defence ahead of the Ark’s advance to the surface into the full-scale 3rd Surface Recapture War, where every force clashes over the fate of humanity. These chapters close the Underground Ark storyline, and a new story arc will be revealed afterwards.
The “MARIA-n” story event follows Marian as she wakes up in an unfamiliar research facility and takes her first steps on the surface. Alongside it, “Fading Affection” is a branching text adventure where players revisit scattered memory fragments to unlock the untold endings of her past.
Commanders can earn up to 259 free recruitment attempts through the NIKKE 4th anniversary events, plus a 4th Anniversary Nikke Selection Box with a choice of Rapunzel: Sanctuary, Chime, Rapunzel: Pure Grace or Snow White: Innocent Days. A profile decoration and development materials are also part of the rewards.
Outside the game, Marian takes over the One Times Square billboard in New York for the whole of October 29, and Animate Los Angeles hosts a NIKKE store event from October 31 to November 14.

item.title: Blue Archive Japan Moves From Yostar to Nexon in January 2027, With 100 Free Recruitments
item.description:
The change was announced on October 25 in an official notice from Yostar and during that evening’s “Blue Archive Live!” autumn broadcast. According to Yostar, NEXON Games, the studio that develops Blue Archive, approached it about a year ago over the future of the service, and the two companies agreed on the move after a long negotiation. The game is not ending: Nexon becomes the operator and the service continues.
Play data, progress, Pyroxenes and every item bought or earned in the game will be transferred to Nexon. The exact steps for moving an account have not been published yet. Nexon has opened a publisher change FAQ and will put the account transfer page online in November.
Announcement from Nexon regarding the future operation of Blue Archive
The Blue Archive publisher change only affects the Japanese service. The global version is already published by Nexon.
Nexon says the switch will not slow the game down: main story and event story updates, new features, live broadcasts, offline events, merchandise and collaborations all continue.
Once the publisher has changed, Nexon will hand out a set of rewards in stages:
The select ticket offers a choice of 13 students: Wakamo, Hoshino (Swimsuit), Mika, Hanako (Swimsuit), Hina (Dress), Hoshino (Armed), Shiroko*Terror, Neru (School), Rio, Mika (Swimsuit), Nagisa (Swimsuit), Aris (Armed) and Kei. Choosing a student who is already on the roster gives 100 of her Eleph instead. Distribution dates and expiry periods will be announced later.

item.title: Chasing Kaleidorider Passes 2 Million Pre-Registrations and Opens Doki Test Sign-Ups
item.description:
Chasing Kaleidorider has surpassed 2 million pre-registrations worldwide, a milestone announced alongside the opening of sign-ups for its next closed beta, the Doki Test. The upcoming 3D romance RPG from Tencent’s Fizzglee Studio is now recruiting testers on both mobile and PC.
The 2-million mark gives Fizzglee Studio a strong signal of global interest ahead of release, particularly for a title that blends anime-style relationship storytelling with motorcycle-themed card battles. The game has been positioning itself as a “RIDER Girl Dokidoki Romance RPG,” with players taking the role of a Navigator alongside its cast of Riders.
The game is being developed by Fizzglee Studio, a subsidiary of Tencent. Chasing Kaleidorider combines a future urban adventure, bike combat, and social romance mechanics. Players build relationships with the game’s RIDER girls while progressing through high-speed strategic card battles, with the studio emphasizing character expression, emotional story scenes, and personal “romantic anecdotes.” Despite the growing pre-registration total and multiple beta phases, an official global release date has not yet been confirmed.
Chasing Kaleidorider pre-registrations remain open through the official website, while the Doki Test recruitment survey is also live for prospective mobile and PC players.
The newly opened Doki Test is the game’s next closed beta and is accepting applications for both platforms:
For now, Fizzglee Studio has not announced a release date, but the Doki Test suggests the developer is moving into a later stage of testing ahead of launch.

item.title: Azur Promilia Launches in Japan on November 26 After 25 Million Pre-Registrations
item.description:
Azur Promilia launches in Japan on November 26, 2026. Yostar, which co-publishes the game with developer Manjuu, confirmed the date on October 23 for iOS, Android and PC. It is free to play with in-game purchases.
The Azur Promilia release date comes with a global pre-registration count of 25 million, which has already unlocked rewards including the character Anis. If the count passes 30 million, every pre-registration reward is unlocked.
Players arrive on the Promilia continent as a figure foretold by prophecy, travelling through a world of different races and cultures and bonding with its creatures, the Kibo. The Kibo fight alongside the party against the calamity threatening the world, and they also help on the farm, the slow-life side of the game where players manage their own land.
Yostar also opened a web campaign on October 23. Players complete quests to run a campsite and raise its prosperity; hitting the targets unlocks in-game items and an event-exclusive outfit for one of the Kibo. The campaign runs until December 31, and claiming the rewards requires linking or logging in with a Yostar ID. Details are on the official Japanese site.
November 26 is the date for the Japanese version. Players waiting for an English release have a longer road: Manjuu has scheduled the English open beta for summer 2027, on a US-based server. In Korea, the game is published by Nexon.

item.title: Genshin Impact 7.2 Arrives November 4 With Mitya, Valeriy and Eastern Snezhnaya
item.description:
The Genshin Impact 7.2 release date was confirmed on October 23 together with the version trailer, and the Archon Quest alone pays out 560 Primogems if it is completed within the version.
As the Nails of Retribution grow more violent, pillars of light appear across Teyvat and trigger the Holy Soil phenomenon, pushing every nation into crisis. The Tsaritsa answers by calling a historic meeting in Snezhnaya, and players fight alongside the Archons, Neuvillette and allies from across Teyvat to stop it.
Beyond the Primogems, the Archon Quest gives Ascension materials for Mitya, and the new round of Secret Tsarist Assignments adds a Snezhnaya-themed Wind Glider.
The new region opens by rail. The line runs to Novokitezhgrad, Snezhnaya’s main producer of Kresnik Kristall, a city built entirely underground and encased in the crystal. Further east lies Wingspan Peak, shaped like a giant wing, and on it Old Kitezhgrad, the first city of Snezhnaya, founded by the Belyi Tsar.
Exploration revolves around cleaning up contaminated Kresnik Kristall deposits with new Prime Ice Constructs and two elemental shotguns. New Meeting Point quests follow Danica on a cleanup job for the Tsaritsa and Mitya as he investigates the soil near Teplo Oasis, and a colossal creature from the ocean depths waits as a new challenge in Novokitezhgrad.
Mitya is a 5-star Electro Catalyst user. In the party he turns Superconduct into Stellar-Conduct reactions, boosts the whole team’s Stellar-Conduct damage and stores a special energy. Tapping his Elemental Skill spends it on periodic Stellar-Conduct damage around him, while holding it unleashes a flurry of enhanced Charged Attacks, so he can work both off-field and on-field. His Burst deals AoE Electro damage and refills that energy.
Valeriy, a Major of the Armory Palace, is a 4-star Electro Sword user who provides shields and raises Electro damage, especially in Stellar-Conduct teams.
Both debut in the first phase of the Event Wishes alongside a Furina rerun. The second phase brings back Zibai and Linnea, plus a new Chronicled Wish with selected Natlan characters.
The main event unlocks through the Archon Quest, or straight away with Quick Start, and has players rescuing soldiers and carrying intel against the Holy Soil. It rewards Primogems, enhancement materials and a free 4-star character of your choice. A filming event in Snezhnaya and a mining challenge in Natlan round out the version, and Miliastra Wonderland gets a masquerade lobby, a free 4-star cosmetic set and more stage editing tools.

item.title: DanMachi: Frontier Zero Is a New Game for PC and Mobile in 2027, With an Original Story by Fujino Omori
item.description:
enish has announced Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Frontier Zero, a new DanMachi game for PC, iOS and Android. It is set for 2027, in Japan and overseas, and its main story is an original written with the help of series author Fujino Omori.
The Japanese title is Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Frontier Zero. Its logo carries the Familia Myth subtitle used across the franchise.
The main draw so far is the plot. enish says Frontier Zero tells a DanMachi story that has not appeared in the light novels or the anime, and that Omori is working with the team on it. Nothing has been said yet about which characters lead it or where it falls in the timeline.
The game will be cross-platform between smartphones and PC. enish has not revealed its genre, how it plays or how it will be monetized, so whether it uses gacha is still unannounced. The DanMachi Frontier Zero 2027 window is the only date given so far.
The announcement came from the game’s official X account, which is where enish says the next details will appear:
Frontier Zero arrives a year after the previous DanMachi mobile title, DanMachi – Battle Chronicle, shut down in Japan and worldwide on September 29, 2025.

item.title: CookieRun: Kingdom and Crumble × The Amazing Digital Circus Crossover Runs Until November 19
item.description:
Each game gets its own story, and the two split the cast differently: Kingdom makes two of them playable, while Crumble makes all seven playable and adds Bubble as a pet.
In Kingdom, Pomni Cookie and Jax Cookie join as Special Cookies you can recruit and keep. Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble, Kinger and Caine Cookie appear as Guest Cookies for the duration of the event.
The story starts with a coding error that drops the circus crew and their tent into the Cookie Kingdom. As glitches spread and distort the world, the Cookies team up with the crew to fight off monsters, find the source of the error and send them home. The event also adds a boss raid against the Abstracted, decor pieces taken from the series such as the Circus Stage and Zooble’s Bar Table, collab-only costumes and MyCookie icing sets.
Devsisters’ update trailer for Kingdom:
Crumble goes further. Every member of the cast is a playable Special Cookie, released in two batches: Pomni, Caine, Ragatha and Kinger from October 22, then Jax, Zooble and Gangle on November 5. Caine’s assistant Bubble joins as a Special pet.
Here the circus tent crashes into the Choco Drop Kingdom, and Caine leads Pomni, Jax and Bubble in fixing a dimensional error. The event dungeon climbs in difficulty stage by stage, with circus characters fighting alongside you, and each clear pays out a collab currency you can trade for Cookies and items in the exchange shop. A harder Night Circus Tent difficulty opens with the second wave on November 5. If you are deciding where the new Cookies fit in a team, our CookieRun: Crumble tier list covers the current roster.
Devsisters says the CookieRun games have passed 300 million cumulative users and 1.5 trillion won in total revenue. The Amazing Digital Circus, created by Gooseworx with Glitch Productions, ended its nine-episode run in June 2026 with more than 1.5 billion YouTube views and around 100 million hours watched on Netflix.
“The Amazing Digital Circus, with its bold imagination, whimsical characters, and passionate fandom, shares many things in common with Cookie Run,” said Devsisters CEO Cho Kil-hyun. Glitch Productions co-founder Luke Lerdwichagul called the crossover a way to bring the series to new audiences and give both fanbases something new.

item.title: Solo Leveling: ARISE 2.5th Anniversary Update BEYOND Is Out With Go Gunhee, Velvet and 500 Free Draws
item.description:
The game also passed 70 million cumulative players around two and a half years after its global launch, and Netmarble Neo is using this update to rework how progression feels: Special Commission is gone, Sung Jinwoo’s level cap goes up and a new growth system rewards beating the hardest bosses.
Holy Guardian Barrier Go Gunhee is a Water Buster and a new take on the Hunters Association chairman. His kit leans on the four guardian beasts: Echo strikes with the power of the Black Tortoise, Waterspout calls on the Azure Dragon and his Burst skill, Heaven-Crushing Strike, hits the whole area around him.
Velvet is a Fire Successor who inherits the ferocity of Adan, the Monarch of Fangs. Her exclusive weapon, Play of Fangs, is a double-bladed spear made from two swords that splits back into dual blades mid-fight. Roar of the Pack pulls enemies together and launches them, Fang Cleave follows up with the swords, and her Ultimate, Pandemonium, sweeps the area. Players deciding whether either is worth their tickets can compare them with the current roster in our Solo Leveling: Arise tier list.
The headline mode is Deep Containment Zone, the first challenge where you field four Hunters instead of three. Teams fight Experiment bosses, harder variants of familiar enemies that add shockwaves, extra spawns and hazards like collapsing zones and gas leaks. It unlocks after beating Igris on Expert and opens as a beta, with Experiment Igris (weak to Water) and Experiment Kargalgan (weak to Wind) rotating every two weeks. A gauge-based combo system called Union unleashes one powerful skill per battle, with extra effects depending on the classes on your team.
The rest of the update reshapes long-term growth:
Netmarble opened the celebration with its 2.5th anniversary PV:
Netmarble is handing out up to 300 Special Draw Tickets through the October update and up to 200 more with the November update. The celebration events add 10,000 Essence Stones and 20 Rate Up Draw Tickets, and the time-limited dungeon Battlefield of Infinity asks you to defeat as many bosses as possible before the clock runs out, paying out Essence Stones, Rate Up Draw Tickets, event materials and Gold by stage.
The redeem code 25THANNIV, announced on the official Solo Leveling: ARISE account, works from October 22 and grants a 2.5th Anniversary SSR Hunter plus an exclusive weapon selection ticket. If you are planning how far those tickets go, the Solo Leveling: Arise Pity Calculator shows the odds and Essence Stone cost of reaching pity.
One platform change lands on the same day: Netmarble’s notices list October 22 as the end of support for the Epic Games Store version.
